dataset.universe_rule: Fixed ex-ante liquidity list of USD-M perpetuals carried by the verified 2025-H1 tapes; identical for every candidate and every control draw.
dataset.tape_identity: research/tape/<symbol>-1h-2025H1, tape_sha256 recorded per run from tape.manifest.json

holdout.unseal_rule: Only after a candidate and all of its parameters are frozen in reports/research/LEDGER.md; the runner refuses a start >= 2025-05-01 unless V9_HOLDOUT_AUTHORIZED=1.

execution_model.entry: MARKET at the next bar open after a signal on a closed bar
execution_model.exit: static bracket, stop 2% / target 4% of entry, stop evaluated before target inside a bar (STOP_FIRST), flat time exit at the close of the 48th held bar
execution_model.funding: actual venue settlements inside the holding window; positive rate paid by longs
execution_model.sizing: risk 100 USDT per campaign (1% of a 10,000 USDT book); R = net PnL / 100

candidates.statement: A one-bar H1 close outside a 2-sigma band of the trailing 20 closes mean-reverts in the opposite direction by more than the round-trip cost, and by more than a random entry at the same eligible times under identical exits.
candidates.direction_rule: LONG below the lower band, SHORT above the upper band
candidates.falsified_by: net expectancy <= 0, or not above the matched random-entry control, or concentration in fewer than 6 of 10 symbols

candidates.statement: An H1 bar with volume at least 4x the median of the prior 50 bars that closes in the extreme 40% of its own range marks exhaustion, and the next bar reverses it by more than the round-trip cost.
candidates.direction_rule: down-climax at the low -> LONG, up-climax at the high -> SHORT
candidates.falsified_by: net expectancy <= 0, or not above the matched random-entry control, or concentration in fewer than 6 of 10 symbols

candidates.statement: An H1 bar that trades through the prior 24-bar extreme and closes back inside the range continues in the reclaim direction by more than the round-trip cost.
candidates.direction_rule: sweep of the prior low with close above it -> LONG, sweep of the prior high with close below it -> SHORT
candidates.falsified_by: net expectancy <= 0, or not above the matched random-entry control, or concentration in fewer than 6 of 10 symbols

random_entry_matched_exits.pool: every bar from warmup to the penultimate bar, priced in BOTH directions under the identical bracket, costs, funding and time exit
random_entry_matched_exits.draw_rule: per symbol, sample without replacement exactly the candidate's trade count for that symbol; pooled statistic is the mean of the per-symbol draw means

unit_of_comparison: per-campaign net R; cross-market clustering unit is the per-symbol mean net R
secondary_metrics: control percentile and one-sided control p-value
symbol mean bootstrap 95% CI (10000 resamples, seed 20260101)
declared sensitivity grid (not used for selection)

gates.multiple_testing: Holm over the three primary candidates tested in one run

decision_rule: DEV_CANDIDATE only when every gate passes; otherwise NO_EDGE, or INCONCLUSIVE when the trade count is below the minimum. DEV_CANDIDATE nominates a candidate for native validation and is not an economic edge claim. PASS can never be awarded by this screen.

hypothesis_budget.trials_declared: 3 primary hypotheses + 10 declared sensitivity variants (4 Bollinger, 4 volume, 2 sweep); sensitivity variants are diagnostic and cannot be selected

known_limitations: the bar path does not model queue position or partial fills
a stop is assumed to fill at the stop price minus declared slippage; gaps are not modelled beyond the bar's own range
funding uses entry notional, not the continuously varying notional
dev and holdout share one six-month regime; the holdout is time-separated, not regime-separated
the screen can nominate but never promote; only a native replay may

amendments.reason: load_bars exposed tape milliseconds as end_ns; a native ns timestamp compared against a bar close skipped every bar and funding could never be attributed. The first execution of the screen was therefore invalid before any result was read: its output was discarded and is not recorded in the ledger.
amendments.scope: unit conversion plus a regression test; hypotheses, parameters, costs, controls, gates and budgets are unchanged
